The maintained replication code behind these errata is at <https://github.com/active-maintenance-aec/coppock_green_porter_2026> and is archived at Zenodo at <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24168353>, a DOI that always resolves to the latest version.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
here::i_am("errata.qmd")

page <- read_csv(here("maintained", "output", "page_values.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
value <- \(id) page$value_rewrite[page$claim_id == id]
f <- \(id, digits = 3) sprintf(str_c("%.", digits, "f"), value(id))

items <- value("index_items")
stopifnot(items == 14)
study_1_n <- value("n_study_1")
stopifnot(study_1_n == value("fig_2a_enrolled"))
index_largest <- f("s1_index_largest", 1)
third <- f("swing_third_republican", 1)
democratic_third <- f("swing_03_09", 1)
third_years <- str_c(value("third_from"), "–", value("third_to"))
hypotheticals <- value("fig_2b_hypotheticals")
stopifnot(hypotheticals == 6, value("s2_overall_below") == 2, value("s1_pro_dem_na") == 24, value("subgroup_significant") == 1)
stopifnot(value("s2_eval_d_p") <= 0.025, value("s2_id_d_p") <= 0.025)

months <- read_csv(here("maintained", "output", "fielding_months.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(study = if_else(str_detect(file, "orig"), "Study 1", "Study 2")) |> group_by(study, month) |> summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(study) |> slice_max(n) |> ungroup()
stopifnot(months$month == c("2023-08", "2024-02"))
month_label <- format(ymd(str_c(months$month, "-01")), "%B %Y")

sixth <- read_csv(here("maintained", "output", "table_a2_sixth_video.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |> filter(dosage_continuous > 0)
stopifnot(all(sixth$sixth[sixth$notaparty > 0] == sixth$notaparty[sixth$notaparty > 0]), all(sixth$sixth[sixth$study != "study_4_dosage"] == sixth$notaparty[sixth$study != "study_4_dosage"]))
sixth_cells <- str_flatten_comma(sixth$sixth)
```

```{r entries}

In the stated direction they are {f('s2_eval_d_p', 4)} (evaluation, {f('s2_eval_d')}, SE {f('s2_eval_d_se')}) and {f('s2_id_d_p', 4)} (identification, {f('s2_id_d')}, SE {f('s2_id_d_se')}), both below the cutoff. Neither survives correction across the 96 tests (Benjamini-Hochberg {f('s2_eval_d_bh')}), and the estimates are about 0.01 on a 0-1 scale. Party ID stays null. Figure 7's numbers are unchanged. Separately, the Study 1 script matches a label it has already renamed, so all {value('s1_pro_dem_na')} of its Pro-Democratic one-sided p-values are missing. ) |>
  mutate(across(c(title, published, corrected, note, claim_ids, corrected_values), as.character))

stopifnot(nrow(entries) == max(entries$entry), !anyDuplicated(entries$entry),
          all(is.na(entries$corrected) == (entries$form == "note")),
          all(!is.na(entries$corrected_values) == (entries$class == "quantity")))

# Each corrected value must sit inside a marked span of its sentence. The result is the spine's
# values_in_spans column: NA for an entry with no values.
values_in_spans <- function(corrected, values) {
  if (is.na(values)) return(NA)
  spans <- str_c(str_extract_all(corrected, "\\[\\[.*?\\]\\]")[[1]], collapse = " ")
  all(str_detect(spans, fixed(str_split(values, ";")[[1]])))
}
entries <- entries |> mutate(values_in_spans = map2_lgl(corrected, corrected_values, values_in_spans))
quantities <- entries |> filter(class == "quantity")
stopifnot(all(quantities$values_in_spans),
          all(str_count(quantities$claim_ids, ";") == str_count(quantities$corrected_values, ";")))

bold <- function(x) str_replace_all(x, "\\[\\[(.*?)\\]\\]", "**\\1**")
emit_entry <- function(n) {
  e <- entries |> filter(entry == n)
  cat("\n\n## ", e$entry, ". ", e$title, "\n\nPublished, ", e$location, ":\n\n> ", bold(e$published), sep = "")
  if (e$form != "note") cat("\n\nCorrected:\n\n> ", bold(e$corrected), sep = "")
  cat("\n\n", e$note, "\n", sep = "")
}
```

This note lists corrections to "Americans can imagine changing partisan affiliation: evidence from hypothetical scenarios," published in the *Quarterly Journal of Political Science* 21(1): 26-48, doi [10.1108/QJPS-02-2025-0026](https://doi.org/10.1108/QJPS-02-2025-0026). Entries 5 and 6 are notes on claims the authors have yet to rule on, and they carry no corrected text. No other entry changes a conclusion of the article. Bold marks each change. Passages separated by a slash are separate sentences or labels. The analysis is in the repository `coppock_green_porter_2026`.

```{r article-entries, results="asis"}
walk(entries$entry, emit_entry)
```

```{r emit-spine}
# The spine's vocabularies are closed (cleanup of 2026-11-07): a value outside them is a
# typo, and the edition builders read these columns to shape every entry.
stopifnot(
  all(entries$class %in% c("quantity", "description", "interpretation", "definition", "label", "float", "cross_reference", "wording", "spelling", "typography", "bibliographic")),
  all(entries$form %in% c("full", "brief", "note")),
  all(entries$source %in% c("pipeline", "reading", "reference_audit", "publisher_record", "authors_archive", "proof"))
)
write_csv(entries, here("errata_entries.csv"))
```
